dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I see Saigon people thích cafe quá. There are so many cafe shops here, I don't know which one to choose.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: That's right! Cafe is part of Saigon's culture. Have you đã tried cà phê sữa đá? It's really ngon and distinctive.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I don't thích sweet things that much. But I must admit cà phê sữa đá here is completely different from Russia. Do Vietnamese people thích sitting at cafe all day?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Not exactly all day, but we like to spend time at cafe chatting. Besides cafe, do you like exploring Ben Thanh market? It's a wonderful nơi to understand Saigon culture.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Ben Thanh market? I đã been there once and got chased by vendors for not buying anything. It was terrifying! Do you know any quieter nơi where I can play chess?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Sorry about that experience. There's a small cafe near 23/9 Park, a nơi where many elderly people play Chinese chess. Perhaps you'll thích that place, though it's not chess but still interesting. How ngon are you at chess?
